verdict.rationale: Avalara documents its own AI: the Avi Agent, AI-assisted explanations of how and why tax was calculated (jurisdiction breakdowns, sourcing, exemption status, compliance rules), conversational transaction queries, and AI tax-code recommendations. That covers the "why did this invoice tax this way" and product-taxability questions from its own rule base. Nothing shows answers come with citations to rules or statutes, and the docs say little about how Avi works. missing for 10: evidence that answers include citations to underlying tax rules, a direct per-state taxability Q&A capability, detailed Avi Agent documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the product ships its own AI for tax questions — is this product taxable in this state, why did this invoice tax this way — answering from its rule base with citations, not a generic chatbot

citations.quote: Explain how and why tax was calculated, with AI-assisted analysis of jurisdiction breakdowns, sourcing decisions, exemption status, and compliance rules.
Integrate, test, and scale compliance with AvaTax MCP servers, Avalara Avi Agent and APIs using the 90-day AvaTax free trial
Analyze accounts faster with conversational queries. Explore transactions in detail to spot patterns or anomalies
Provides AI-powered tax code recommendations for products. Returns 1 to 3 ranked tax code suggestions with confidence levels
